documentation_status: Finalized on 10 October after the original 9 October planning cutoff, before the confirmed extended official deadline of 16 October 2026 at 23:59 BST.

scored_evaluation_status.infrastructure_partials: Retained separately. V4-M5 final aggregate reused one valid original row plus seven isolated scene processes; V3-M6 ran a separate complete retry. Partials are not extra independent trials.

gaps.finding: All robot rollouts were simulated. Original human footage is real, but does not contain a physical robot execution.
gaps.claim_precluded: Real-robot deployment, factory qualification, sim-to-real success or physical sensor validation.

gaps.finding: Phone-view synchronization was audited, and simulated RGB/action ordering was checked separately. Human intermediate actions and pauses were not aligned one-for-one to measured robot commands.
gaps.claim_precluded: Direct measured human-video-to-robot-action imitation or native robot-action labels for the human clips.

gaps.finding: Early proxy geometry/mass and later catalogue appearance values were declared simulator inputs, not measurements of the filmed object. The homography was dimensionless.
gaps.claim_precluded: Measured real-object size, mass, friction, contact force or physical camera calibration.

gaps.finding: The original small task selector did run behavioural cloning and PPO. Personal X-VLA adaptation and V4 aggregation did not run PPO or Q-learning.
gaps.claim_precluded: Either a global claim that PPO was never run or a claim that V4 was reinforcement learning.

gaps.finding: The shuffled-label control recovered after PPO; history and disturbed-source conditions did not establish an advantage on held-out compositions.
gaps.claim_precluded: Demonstration-specific or history-specific benefit from the initial selector pilot.

gaps.finding: Personal and synthetic conditions differed in layouts/goals and shared appearance. Later data versions changed several supervision and cue choices.
gaps.claim_precluded: An isolated causal estimate of personal versus synthetic data quality.

gaps.finding: Prompt/head/LoRA changes and later base-checkpoint/domain/loss changes were not all held fixed. Original M5/M6 each used one source trajectory.
gaps.claim_precluded: A clean ranking of LoRA versus full tuning or a claim that all personal demonstrations trained those checkpoints.

gaps.finding: Actual V3 added causal sparse history and physical-time anchors, with timing audits and expert replays. Runtime requests remained externally supplied; mean-pooled history compressed temporal information.
gaps.claim_precluded: A validated online learned subgoal selector, learned-value planning or task success caused by temporal abstraction.

gaps.finding: Held-state cues, camera candidates, balancing and scene variation existed. Privileged annotations were distinguished from runtime unknowns.
gaps.claim_precluded: A deployable held-state estimator or general robustness to unseen cameras, lighting, objects and dynamics.

gaps.finding: Accepted teacher additions followed unfinished six-second student prefixes. This does not establish irrecoverable failure. Three explicit empty-grasp attempts yielded no clean accepted empty-grasp correction.
gaps.claim_precluded: Repeated autonomous failure discovery, guaranteed recovery supervision, or an established benefit from DAgger.

gaps.finding: Models shared the same eight cases. The common 1.5-second and separate four-second conditions are different protocols. Four trained V1/V2 M5/M6 combinations were unevaluated in the common set.
gaps.claim_precluded: Independent-trial interpretation of all rows, all sixteen branches evaluated, broad statistical generalization or a pooled cross-horizon success rate.

gaps.finding: V4-M6 personal_demo_0006 grasped, lifted about 161.4 mm, moved about 246.3 mm and released stably inside target. Position error 11.36 mm passed; yaw error 85.06 degrees was the sole failed final criterion.
gaps.claim_precluded: Completed manipulation or orientation correction, and conversely a claim that no learned policy ever grasped or transported an object.

gaps.finding: Qwen confidently accepted a reversed numeral in one live case; another wrong-yaw case produced malformed/truncated JSON. Independent RGB and stateful guards were added.
gaps.claim_precluded: Reliable general completion judgment or conflating assisted service outcomes with unassisted policy scores.

gaps.finding: The fixed-overhead feeding classifier had no false completions in a 336-image confirmation and abstained on 91 images. Its softmax is uncalibrated. Loading is unsupported.
gaps.claim_precluded: Zero deployment false-positive rate, calibrated confidence, real-camera accuracy, arbitrary-camera operation or validated fine angular-boundary performance.

gaps.finding: The classifier supplies visual evidence; the service additionally checks measured gripper opening and fresh-frame translation stability. A coarse direction class does not measure two-degree continuous yaw stability, support height or physical contact.
gaps.claim_precluded: An image alone certifies every physical task-success or safety criterion.

gaps.finding: Three precompleted placements were recognized with no policy actions. Wrong orientations were rejected and an opaque image stayed unknown. The 500-decision source attempt executed 49 actions and did not finish.
gaps.claim_precluded: Harness-assisted learned source completion or treating 500 service decisions as 1500 executed control steps.

gaps.finding: Candidate filtering and per-step checks were bounded. Telemetry reports simulator state and actuator torque. The simulator paused during inference; many classifier calls took quick unknown branches.
gaps.claim_precluded: A generally safe whole-arm controller, real force measurements, calibrated physical robot latency or real-time end-to-end throughput.

gaps.finding: The first 51,332-byte history and 57-source index were saved and verified, then the host became unreachable. This publication copy was reconstructed from the reviewed notes. Original hashes are retained where known; missing paths/hashes are null instead of invented.
gaps.claim_precluded: Byte identity with the first history, recovery of all original source copies or independent rereading of the final evaluation summary after the outage.
gaps.follow_up: When access returns, reconcile against the preserved first history/source index and mirror any missing final evidence without changing the experiments.

gaps.finding: The final local index contained 64 videos; the earlier public release was frozen at 56 and excluded the final two local suites.
gaps.claim_precluded: The earlier public media gallery is the complete final evaluation inventory.
